My only negative is that because this is Bosch's lowest model, the bottom of the dishwasher is plastic, it is not stainless steel. I wish it was fully stainless steel and not plastic. But overall, I spent so much time researching and our repair man recommended Bosch and I am very happy with this purchase! One additional pro is that the top 3rd tray I much deeper than the GE so I can fit much more knives and utensils up there. And I honestly don't really trust the service technician that was sent. He blamed the problem on our cold well water. That's just a lot of garbage and I think he was too hung over to come up with a better excuse. I'll keep experimenting with the wash and dry settings and make another service call if needed. Sentence (English): PROS: This dishwasher looks great and installation was easy.
Comments (English): [ Feels like two steps back from the 2011 Model ] || ---------------- || PROS: This dishwasher looks great and installation was easy. The manual was written for people with a higher degree of skill than the average American person but overall, it was not a difficult installation (for me) and it was my first time ever installing one, let alone watching anyone else install one. Next PRO: It has greater capacity than my old dishwasher and the turbo dry / steam mode is great. This is a good technological step up from my previous GE Profile dishwasher (circa 2011).CONS:The dishwasher has a stainless steel tub that is not unibody construction, apparently - it has a seam that runs just above the base of the tub and it had a bead of silicone in the seam and it was dirty, yucky and not inspiring to clean out. I kept wondering "if I pull the excess silicone off, will the tub leak? " So I ran three loads with the dishwasher sitting in the middle of my kitchen for two days while running test loads - to check for leaks and clean the insdie really well. Next CON: The door " Latch" - I have the Profile model where you pull open and push close - there is no mechanical latch. In concept, one would like the idea *but* it requires a good amount of force to open and close the door and the door is made of lighter gauge metal so it actually flexes a little when operning/closing the dishwasher. I have a granite countertop and my counter was built with gaps on the side so the only place to anchor the dishwasher was a piece of wood that was glued along the top of the opening so all of that energy gets transfered to that wood - I hope it holds. As far as the door flexing is concerned, I'm very concerned about build quality years down the road. It's worth the extended warranty for that alone.Next CON: This model has the fine filter and a sump in the base of the tub and by design, the water does *not* drain completely out of the tub. Apparently, this is standard operating procedure foe dishwashers so prepare yourself for an odor if you do not run dishwasher loads every single day. It would be great if there was a way to force the dishwasher to run its drain pump manually.Next CON: Be prepared for long running loads - in excess of 3 hours! I just replaced my old GE Profile model from circa 2011 with this one and it literally feels like it runs longer than the old one.It is also a little louder than the older model. These are my initial impressions and I have not read the manual yet so hopefully the programming of the wash modes is more flexible than they appear to be. I was hoping to run quicker washes and heat only/ rinse only modes but I'm not seeing how to do that yet. I will dig into this for sure.

This is a good technological step up from my previous GE Profile dishwasher (circa 2011).CONS:The dishwasher has a stainless steel tub that is not unibody construction, apparently - it has a seam that runs just above the base of the tub and it had a bead of silicone in the seam and it was dirty, yucky and not inspiring to clean out.  I kept wondering 'if I pull the excess silicone off, will the tub leak???' So I ran three loads with the dishwasher sitting in the middle of my kitchen for two days while running test loads - to check for leaks and clean the insdie really well.  Next CON: The door ' Latch' - I have the Profile model where you pull open and push close - there is no mechanical latch. In concept, one would like the idea *but* it requires a good amount of force to open and close the door and the door is made of lighter gauge metal so it actually flexes a little when operning/closing the dishwasher. I have a granite countertop and my counter was built with gaps on the side so the only place to anchor the dishwasher was a piece of wood that was glued along the top of the opening so all of that energy gets transfered to that wood - I hope it holds. As far as the door flexing is concerned, I'm very concerned about build quality years down the road.  It's worth the extended warranty for that alone.Next CON: This model has the fine filter and a sump in the base of the tub and by design,  the water does *not* drain completely out of the tub.  Apparently, this is standard operating procedure foe dishwashers so prepare yourself for an odor if you do not run dishwasher loads every single day.  It would be great if there was a way to force the dishwasher to run its drain pump manually.Next CON: Be prepared for long running loads - in excess of 3 hours! I just replaced my old GE Profile model from circa 2011 with this one and it literally feels like it runs longer than the old one.It is also a little louder than the older model. These are my initial impressions and I have not read the manual yet so hopefully the programming of the wash modes is more flexible than they appear to be.  I was hoping to run quicker washes and heat only/ rinse only modes but I'm not seeing how to do that yet.  I will dig into this for sure.

Sentence (English): Installation:I've tackled a few dishwasher installations over the years, and this dishwasher was by far the easiest to install.
Comments (English): [ Simple to install, and very powerful cleaning jets ] || ---------------- || Installation:I've tackled a few dishwasher installations over the years, and this dishwasher was by far the easiest to install. The measurements given for this dishwasher, combined with the measurements suggested for perfect fit, are both absolutely spot on. It's nearly impossible to incorrectly install this dishwasher as long as your opening fits within the parameters listed in the product page, and instructions. All basic hardware is included to hook the dishwasher up. Once installed, the fit of this dishwasher in my space looks perfect; all gaps are minimal and perfectly uniform. Fingerprints:The entire front of this dishwasher is fingerprint avoidant; and, after installation, I can definitely confirm this dishwasher is in fact fingerprint avoidant. Noise level:When I'm in the kitchen, I can just barely pick up on this dishwasher running through cleaning cycles, but it's certainly fairly quiet. Cleaning:Just about any modern, high-end dishwasher is going to clean dishes very well, but this unit gets our dishes absolutely spotless. Deep cleaning silverware jets:In addition to the fact this dishwasher is powerful enough to get our dishes spotless, it's hands down the best dishwasher we've ever installed and used in terms of cleaning silverware. The specially designed deep cleaning silverware jets on this dishwasher are absolutely amazing at cleaning our silverware. Space:We are a family of five, and there's enough space in this dishwasher that we don't have to run it more than twice a day. On our previous dishwasher, we averaged running it three times a day. Seals:There's absolutely no leaking or seeping of any kind with this dishwasher. Shaking and vibration:I made sure to perfectly balance this dishwasher before final installation, and that's been good enough to ensure that it doesn't shake, or vibrate at all. Control panel:Simple enough not to be confusing, while being complex enough to keep up with what you'd expect from a fully featured, modern dishwasher. Bottom line:I'm extremely happy with this dishwasher. While I can't comment on long-term performance, I've never been more impressed with any dishwasher we've owned, than I am with this one. Highly recommended 5 stars

Sentence (English): After owning a Smeg dishwasher for 8 years (which was great) it stopped working and was too expensive to repair for its age, it was time for a new one.
Comments (English): [ I downgraded from a Smeg to a Haier. but did I? ] || ---------------- || After owning a Smeg dishwasher for 8 years (which was great) it stopped working and was too expensive to repair for its age, it was time for a new one. After much consideration I chose the Haier. This was based on looks, features and price point. Considering the price difference between Smeg and Haier, to be honest there isn't much difference. The racks in my Smeg dishwasher seemed a bit sturdier and it was very hard to hear at all, but that's about it. The Haier is still quiet, the features are similar but the Haier takes way less time per wash. You still get water left on plastics, I have never had a dishwasher that completely dries plastics. Sentence (English): Love all the features like the display that shows status, wifi that sends notifications (although a trick to find the proper combination of buttons to activate), the ultrafresh system, and the silverware sprayer.
Comments (English): [ Love the features, the install though.  ] || ---------------- || Love all the features like the display that shows status, Wi-Fi that sends notifications (although a trick to find the proper combination of buttons to activate), the ultrafresh system, and the silverware sprayer. Haven't found a need for the bottle sprayers though. As for the install, it was extremely frustrating (and I've installed several dishwashers). The legs are hard to work with to get the unit level (impossible to reach the back ones), and the insulation for the toe kick is impossible to work with (I gave for now). Whomever designed this needs to install the unit several times so they realize that one the toe kick is so far back it's hard to reach the screws, and two the screws are so short you have to fight the plate and insulation to try and get them in. Finally, as I left the toe kick off, the first time I ran the unit I ended up with water on the floor (didn't have Wi-Fi enabled yet to alert me of a leak). Seems the filler box on the side of the unit was turned sideways, and therefore the air gap was allowing water to spill out every time the unit filled. Took me a few to find the issue, but I taped the plastic unit into the proper orientation so it wouldn't move while I fought to slide it back into place. Final complaint: the wheels and racks feel cheap, my 15 yo previous dishwasher rolled so much better and had more weight to them.

The legs are hard to work with to get the unit level (impossible to reach the back ones), and the insulation for the toe kick is impossible to work with (I gave for now). Whomever designed this needs to install the unit several times so they realize that one the toe kick is so far back it's hard to reach the screws, and two the screws are so short you have to fight the plate and insulation to try and get them in. Finally, as I left the toe kick off, the first time I ran the unit I ended up with water on the floor (didn't have Wi-Fi enabled yet to alert me of a leak). Seems the filler box on the side of the unit was turned sideways, and therefore the air gap was allowing water to spill out every time the unit filled. Took me a few to find the issue, but I taped the plastic unit into the proper orientation so it wouldn't move while I fought to slide it back into place. Final complaint: the wheels and racks feel cheap, my 15 yo previous dishwasher rolled so much better and had more weight to them.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher can hold a lot!
Comments (English): [ Good but not perfect ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher can hold a lot! Which is really nice! Some taller things (such as cookie sheets) don't fit well, a sacrifice for the bigger third row I suppose. Most of the time it also cleans really well. I love being able to take out the silverware tray on the bottom rack and use the one on the third rack when I only have a few pieces, however I have found a few times where the silverware up there doesn't get perfectly clean. I have also found that certain taller items (pitchers or half gallon mason jars) have to be placed more centrally which is hard with also washing plates. This is unfortunately a problem with most dishwashers (which I understand from the layout of the spray arms). I would really love to see some specific water spraying spikes for water bottles and other tall items in the corners of the bottom shelf (like other manufacturers have on the second row, which doesn't make much sense for tall water bottles that won't fit on the second row). All in all I am happy with it, but wouldn't buy the exact same one again if I had to, but would definitely consider another KitchenAid if it had those other features.

Sentence (English): It has been a little under a month of usage and I have had no mechanical problems.
Comments (English): [ So Far, So Good! ] || ---------------- || It has been a little under a month of usage and I have had no mechanical problems. This model is quiet and does a great job cleaning dishes. I have noticed that the drying function does "okay" drying the dishes, but the unit itself remains damp with water condensation remains on the inside of the door. Again, I have only had this unit for a few weeks, so it definitely could be user error : ). Installation was NOT easy at all, but again, myself and a friend installed it ourselves. Should be noted, we NEEDED to install the wood insert that was provided in the box to properly install this unit as the height of the unit was not quite tall enough to fill the space. Which according to dimensions listed, the unit should have fit properly. (with the wood unit, the dimensions were correct) Also, I had to spray paint the wood insert (from light colored wood) to match the black coloring of the unit's trim so it wouldn't look weird under the countertop. Also, this unit was not a "plug and go" unit, it needed to be hard wired to power source. Which, my friend was familiar with and was able to complete. If you are not confident drilling the wood insert to the mounting unit under the countertop AND you are not confident hardwiring electrical power cords, then I would suggest allowing/paying the store you bought it from to install this unit.

Second, internal design is superior, and better allows for large objects like mixing bowls or may be packed quite tightly with dishes depending on the need. Sentence (English): There is a lot to like about this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, not so good at drying ] || ---------------- || There is a lot to like about this dishwasher. I love the clean look of it once installed. Very simple push-button operation. Lots of small things inside the racks make it a pleasure to use. There is a small thin third rack on the top that turns out to be very useful. The middle rack can be removed very easily if you need a ton of room or raised or lowered if you just need a bit more room. A few of the rack dividers fold down for larger items. All in all very well thought out. The biggest feature I love is how quiet it is! Seriously, I don't even know it's on from the other room and sometimes you really have to stop and listen for it even once standing in the kitchen! One issue I have is the drying! The dry cycle takes quite a long time and the dishes rarely come out fully dry. I've started using the extended dry cycle but that adds about TWO HOURS to the total cycle time it seems. Even then, the dishes often come out wet and moist! I'm not talking about the puddles of water that will always be present on the underside of mugs or things like that. I mean plates that are vertically placed inches away from the drying element in the bottom of the dishwasher frequently come out with a thin layer of moisture on the surface of the plates! I'd say about 80% of the time we run this we have to remove all the dishes one by one and hand dry them with a towel. How annoying! I'm sure this is a "defect" on purpose to get some stupid government low energy score, but frankly I don't care. I am not trying to save the planet I'm trying to do my darn dishes and part of that is a good dry cycle! Rinse agents be d*mned, they don't help. Dishes are constantly wet after a 3 hour cycle? Not happy with that.Other than the drying issue this machine is perfect. Go to the search bar in the purchase reviews and type "drying" and see what comes up, I'm not the only one…If you can live with that, then this is a great machine.

Tough market, dishwashers cost a fortune these days. We really should have just overhauled our old one — it was moldy, needed new gaskets and filter changing, a lot of work, but the motor was great and it was roomy.

Sentence (English): I installed this new GE about a week ago and have run about five or so loads of dishes.
Comments (English): [ A really good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I installed this new GE about a week ago and have run about five or so loads of dishes. The first thing I will mention is that they've been able to shrink the front control panel to just a few inches tall. This is nice because it lets you see what the dishwasher is doing - since you can barely hear it - while still looking as pretty as a top-control unit. For me, that's important because nice things make me happy =) On the other hand, my wife loves it because it hides fingerprints much better than the unit it replaced. She's also in love with this new bottle jet cleaner, which I'll admit is nice when you have kids and tons and tons of bottles to clean. O - and we switched from the brand without powered drying. THANK GOD! Everything is dry again! One last thing, the Deep Clean Silverware Jets. This was something I'd never seen before. They've taken 40+ water jets and positioned them directly underneath the silverware tray. It claims to be able to clean silverware that was full of junk and crammed in by blasting the entire area with lots and lots of water. I put it to the test by asking my 7yr old to put a full load of silverware in - I didn't rearrange a thing. It came out clean! I was impressed, and if you've ever seen the work of a 7-year-old loading a dishwasher, you will know what I'm talking about. Claim confirmed. Installation was pretty simple. I did it after dinner and was done by 9:00 pm. That being said, I have some construction experience from my earlier days. If you're thinking of installing it on your own but aren't sure, I would encourage you to try if you are replacing a unit because you should have everything you need right there. If not, you'll need to run some electrical (not as daunting as most people make it out to be, but if you aren't comfortable, find an electrician). You'll also need a 1.5-inch hole saw, a Sawzall (or something like it), and a "shark bite" Tee fitting to tap into the water line. If you have this shipped as I did, the packaging is also commendable. It came with a wood frame to protect it in transit. Given everything this thing does and does well, how good it looks and how the Deep Clean Silverware Jets tackle tough jobs, I give this 5 stars. I am hard-pressed to find a complaint. If that changes, I'll edit the review.

Sentence (English): Installation - I had watched a lot of videos on installing a dishwasher and figured I could do it.
Comments (English): [ Amazing cleaning power and cool features! ] || ---------------- || Installation - I had watched a lot of videos on installing a dishwasher and figured I could do it. I got about half way and ran into a few issues so I did what any self respecting woman in their 30s would do…I called my dad for help. He was able to help me get it installed the rest of the way. My initial hiccup in installation was definitely operator error and not the fault of the dishwashers. Design - I love the look of this! It is such a simple and sleek design. The front is not busy with buttons as they are on the top of the door and the front only has a simple light to indicate cycle status. Maybe the biggest selling point for me though was the fingerprint resistant design; as a mom of two young kids, this is such a nice and necessary feature to have. Operation - I am really happy with how efficient this is; my dishes have never been cleaner and it runs very quiet. I love having a third shelf for all of my kid's stuff as well (like all of the different pieces to their sippy cups and water bottles). We are on well water so our water is rather hard and our old dishwasher never seemed to dry our dishes, even with a drying solution. In this dishwasher however, the DryBoost feature manages to get everything dry and I couldn't be happier with it. SmartHQ - The SmartHQ feature is a pretty awesome feature to have. It was very easy to set up and connect and the interface is easy to use. I love that it will notify me when the cycle is complete because I am more likely to unload it right then versus letting them sit there for days on end. My husband is determined to make our entire house a smart house and this definitely brings us one step further. Overall, I am so happy with this dishwasher and would definitely recommend!

Sentence (English): I installed this new GE about a week ago and have run about five or so loads of dishes.
Comments (English): [ A really good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I installed this new GE about a week ago and have run about five or so loads of dishes. The first thing I will mention is that they've been able to shrink the front control panel to just a few inches tall. This is nice because it lets you see what the dishwasher is doing - since you can barely hear it - while still looking as pretty as a top-control unit. For me, that's important because nice things make me happy =)On the other hand, my wife loves it because it hides fingerprints much better than the unit it replaced. She's also in love with this new bottle jet cleaner, which I'll admit is nice when you have kids and tons and tons of bottles to clean. O - and we switched from the brand without powered drying. THANK GOD! Everything is dry again! One last thing, the Deep Clean Silverware Jets. This was something I'd never seen before. They've taken 40+ water jets and positioned them directly underneath the silverware tray. It claims to be able to clean silverware that was full of junk and crammed in by blasting the entire area with lots and lots of water. I put it to the test by asking my 7yr old to put a full load of silverware in - I didn't rearrange a thing. It came out clean! I was impressed, and if you've ever seen the work of a 7-year-old loading a dishwasher, you will know what I'm talking about. Claim confirmed. Installation was pretty simple. I did it after dinner and was done by 9:00 pm. That being said, I have some construction experience from my earlier days. If you're thinking of installing it on your own but aren't sure, I would encourage you to try if you are replacing a unit because you should have everything you need right there. If not, you'll need to run some electrical (not as daunting as most people make it out to be, but if you aren't comfortable, find an electrician). You'll also need a 1.5-inch hole saw, a Sawzall (or something like it), and a "shark bite" Tee fitting to tap into the water line.If you have this shipped as I did, the packaging is also commendable. It came with a wood frame to protect it in transit. Given everything this thing does and does well, how good it looks and how the Deep Clean Silverware Jets tackle tough jobs, I give this 5 stars. I am hard-pressed to find a complaint. If that changes, I'll edit the review.

Comments (English): [ Amazing cleaning power and cool features! ] || ---------------- || Installation - I had watched a lot of videos on installing a dishwasher and figured I could do it. I got about half way and ran into a few issues so I did what any self respecting woman in their 30s would do…I called my dad for help. He was able to help me get it installed the rest of the way. My initial hiccup in installation was definitely operator error and not the fault of the dishwashers.Design - I love the look of this! It is such a simple and sleek design. The front is not busy with buttons as they are on the top of the door and the front only has a simple light to indicate cycle status. Maybe the biggest selling point for me though was the fingerprint resistant design; as a mom of two young kids, this is such a nice and necessary feature to have.Operation - I am really happy with how efficient this is; my dishes have never been cleaner and it runs very quiet. I love having a third shelf for all of my kid's stuff as well (like all of the different pieces to their sippy cups and water bottles). We are on well water so our water is rather hard and our old dishwasher never seemed to dry our dishes, even with a drying solution. In this dishwasher however, the DryBoost feature manages to get everything dry and I couldn't be happier with it.SmartHQ - The SmartHQ feature is a pretty awesome feature to have. It was very easy to set up and connect and the interface is easy to use. I love that it will notify me when the cycle is complete because I am more likely to unload it right then versus letting them sit there for days on end. My husband is determined to make our entire house a smart house and this definitely brings us one step further.Overall, I am so happy with this dishwasher and would definitely recommend!

Sentence (English): I appreciate having a working dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Sound, Lights, and Loading Options ] || ---------------- || I appreciate having a working dishwasher. I LOVE how quietly this one runs and how nice it looks. I LOVE the lights that show the status of the dishwasher's cleaning process (washing, drying, done). It appears that the engineers who designed the racks for this model have NEVER used a dishwasher before and DON'T care about those who do. The upper rack grid spacings are too wide to hold small items that would otherwise be placed there. I absolutely HATE loading this model. It is difficult to get all the items loaded just for 2 adults. I dread having company because I expect to need to run this dishwasher twice as often to clean all the dishes and cooking utensils from meals for 6 people. Again, I AM thankful for a working dishwasher but I wish I had done without longer and waited for a different brand and model that had better loading options than this one.

Comments (English): [ Superior Machine at a Reasonable Price ] || ---------------- || When it became time to replace my 22-year-old dishwasher (also a Bosch), I put some time into researching the newest products, comparing features, prices. and availability. After all this preparation, I admit that I was disappointed once my SHPM78Z55N was installed and, after checking to ensure that it was working, the installer left The first time I tried to wash a load of dishes later than day, I couldn't get the machine to start. I went back and read the owner's manual again. Several other abortive attempts followed. The machine would come on, but within a couple of minutes at the most, the info light would go out and the machine would stop. Finally, luck smiled on me, though: the machine came on, stayed on, and when the wash cycle was through, the results were sparkling clean dishes. "Okay," I thought. "I've got it down now."You know what they say about pride and it's arrival. The next time I tried to start a load, I had the same problem. This time, luck didn't come to my aid, and the dishes were still unwashed the next day when my appliance dealer called to follow up on the installation and make sure I wasn't having any problems. I explained what was happening to him, and he suggested that I try throwing the dishwasher circuit breaker and letting it stay off for 10 minutes before trying to restart, so I did. I think luck was enjoying toying with me, because this time on the first try the machine started and stayed on. However, the next time I tried to wash a load, I was right back to the cycle cutting off almost immediately. An assessment of my predicament suggested the strong possibility that if the machine worked some times but not others, it was more likely due to operator error than machine failure, so I pulled the owner's manual out again and went through it page by page while standing in front of the machine. And, yep--operator error it was. I hadn't understood how to properly turn the machine on and off and had, instead, been punching in a setting that told the machine to do exactly what it had been doing. As the Germans would say, "Dummkopf! "So I'm now wiser and a happy camper. The Bosch does an outstanding job of cleaning my dishes. I love little things like the info light. The machine is so quiet that, especially after my rocky start with learning to operate it, it's nice to have that visual reassurance that there's actually something happening behind that closed door. I frequently find myself taking advantage of the MyWay Third Rack to gain space, and I really like the convenience of being able to not only raise or lower the top rack, but also to adjust the two sides independently of each other to make the most efficient use of space in all parts of the interior. Since I live alone, the ability to do a half-load is a nice feature. And Crystal Dry! When I'd read about it, it seemed too good to be true, but it actually works! No more plastic items that need to be put in the sink to finish drying after I empty the dishwasher. Given my age, the machine may well outlive me. If it does, it will add value to the house when the property is sold. In the meantime I'm enjoying my new dishwasher!

Sentence (English): Bosch 300 series is an average dishwasher to get the job done.
Comments (English): [ Good everyday use dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Bosch 300 series is an average dishwasher to get the job done. The dishes came out clean and dry by using Normal mode with Extra Dry option along with drying aide or liquid. The installation was easy and straight forward by connecting the water pipe from your existing pipe and plug in the supplied electrical cord. The drain pipe has sufficient length to connect to the garbage disposal or kitchen drain pipe. This dishwasher doesn't come with insulation blanket as you see from most dishwashers. I used the blanket from my old dishwasher as an extra layer of sound insulation. The noise level is quiet when in use probably with or without the blanket. It has a red light indicator display on the bottom of the dishwasher on to the floor when in washing mode which is a nice feature. It has three levels of loading racks. The racks seem to be sticking and not rolling smoothly and hoping they will be smooth after couple months of use. It uses Pure Dry technology and it doesn't have the heating element as you would see in the inside bottom of the dishwasher. The dishes may not be as dry if you're using certain modes and not using the drying aide or liquid. Overall, I'm pleased with the product and it fits my needs.

Sentence (English): First, I was given the opportunity to use the product through the Coupang Experience Group.
Comments (English): [ hmm.  ] || ---------------- || First, I was given the opportunity to use the product through the Coupang Experience Group. I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd. They said that some of the materials were out of stock, so the delivery was stopped, and they told me about it and that they would install it around the 20th. I was completely shocked by the absurdity of the sudden statement-.-; I was trying to clean up the clutter of the table and appliances that had filled the living room to find the location and set it up again, and I was annoyed for the second time! Then, on the evening of the 14th, I got a happy call and they said they would come and install it between 12 and 1 PM on the 15th, so I told them to do so. As expected, they didn't come even though the time was up~ They called me saying they were late and came to install it after 2:30 -.-; The installation went smoothly after that, and they explained it well, but there was no specific reason or apology for the delay. The kitchen is small, so I couldn't tear down the sink or install a new one, so I requested a freestanding one and installed it. After installation, I put some old appliances on the countertop, such as a Nespresso Vertuo, blender, foamer, and electric kettle, and they are stable. First, since there is no dedicated detergent, I bought detergent today and tried it out. When I test-drove it after installation yesterday, the noise was so loud that it was annoying, but when I put the dishes in and turned it on, it was so quiet that I wondered if it was working. The noise and vibration were okay. I think the noise was caused by the water hitting the inside walls of the dishwasher in the empty space on the first day. If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (Original): [ 음... ] || ---------------- || 일단은 쿠팡체험단 통해서 제품을 사용할 수 있는 기회를 제공 받았다. 생활 편의 지수를 확 끌어 올려준다는 소위 3대 이모님 중에 하나인 식세기를 선택하고 너무 기대하고 있었는데 일단 배송 때문에 초반부터 김도 빠지고 진도 빠짐-.-;  그렇게 이삼일 지나고 연유를 들었는데 더 황당.  일부 자재가 재고가 없어 배송이 중단되었고 그 내용을 본인에게 전달했으며 20일경 설치를 하겠다 고지했다고 함. 뜬금없는 소리에 황당한건 온전히 나의 몫-.-; 위치잡고 다시 셋팅하려고 거실 한가득 깔아놨던 테이블 가전 등 잡동사니들 치우려니 2차로 짜증이!!!  그러다 14일 저녁에 해피콜이 와서 15일 12-1시 사이에 와서 설치를 하겠다길래 그러라 함. ㅎㅎ 역시 시간이 다 되었는데도 안오심~ 늦는다 연락오고 2:30지나서 설치하러 오심 -.-; 그 이후 설치는 무난했고 설명도 잘 해주셨지만 왜 지연이 되었는지 구체적 사유도, 사과도 없었음. 주방이 좁은 편이라 싱크장을 뜯을 수도, 새로 짜기도 뭣해 프리스텐딩으로 요청해 설치했다. 설치후엔 상판위에 네스프레소 버츄오, 블랜더, 포머, 전기포트등 자질구래한 가전 올려뒀는데 안정적이다. 일단 전용세제가 없어 오늘 세제 구매를 하고 작동시켜보았다. 어제 설치후에 시운전 했을때는 소리가 너무 커서 거슬렸는데 막상 그릇을 넣고 돌리니 넘 조용해서 작동되는건가? 싶어 나와서 체크를 할 정도로 소음과 진동은 괜찮은 편이다.  아마 첫날은 빈공간에 물살이 세척기 내부 벽면을 때리면서 소음이 좀 발생한 것이었던것 같다. 이왕이면 혹하게 테스트 하려고 삼겹살 격하게 코팅 구운팬, 마라탕 해먹은 무쇠웍 넣고 기름기 잔뜩 묻은 세라믹들과 실리콘집게 내열용 다회용기 등을 넣고 표준코스로 가동해 보았다. 경과는 코팅팬, 세라믹, 플라스틱내열용기, 실리콘등은 기름기 말끔히 제거 되어 깔끔! 무쇠는 제대로 세척이 잘 안되었고 얼룩과 음식 잔여물이 좀 남아있었음. 커피잔도  크레마 닿았던 부분이 완전 깔끔하게 지지 않음. 세제 용량, 코스, 그릇 위치, 그릇 모양 등 여러 변수가 작용한 결과인것 같다. 일인가구지만 욕심이 많은 맥시멀주의자라 그릇도 많고 유행하는 무쇠도 많고 해서 12인용을 선택한건 탁월한 선택 같음. 또 무쇠나 큰 사이즈 조리도구는 무거워 세척시 손목에 무리 많이 갔는데 애벌로 간단히 헹궈 세척기에 넣어놓기만 하면 해결이되니 생각보다 편리하다~  뭣 보다 손 오래 안적시고, 세제 덜만지고, 배 안젖는거 젤 만족! 그릇이 적긴 하지만 기름이 쎈 것들이라 수용성 캡슐형 세제로 두개 넣었고, 린스는 따로 하지 않았지만 기름기 다 닦였고 남는 얼룩도 없었다. 취향껏 세제 선택하시면 될 듯~ 세척 다 끝나면 삐삐 알람후에 자동으로 문 열리고~ 안에 세제 투입구도 자동으로 오픈이된다~ 추후 건조도 트라이 해봐야지~ 배송만 속을 안썪였었으별 4개 정도는 줬을거다. 이래서 국산 브랜드를 소비해야 하나 다시한번 생각한 계기가 되었고, 설치기사님들께 여쭤보니 미디어 소속 분들이 아니고 그냥 외부 설치업체에 위탁해 설치와 에프터서비스 일부를 처리하는것 같은데 그러니 늦어지고 전문적이지 못한것 같다. 세척은 처음 결과로 봤을땐 일단 만족도 80% 정도. 무쇠 등이 제대로 안닦인것이 세척력의 문제인지, 그릇 재질 자체의 문제인지 좀더 활용을 해봐야 할것 같다. 그럼에도 앞서 말한바와 같이 편리한 점이 있고 가격 측면을 생각하면 충분히 가성비가 있다고 생각함. 외관이 예쁘지는 않지만 그것도 가성비로 커버할 수 있을 정도~ 작동은 더 없이 간단하고 직관적이다. 중간에 설거지물을 추가할 수 있는 것도 괜찮은것 같고~ 올 스텐 내부면도 위생상 좋을 것 같다.  프리스텐딩 팁? 전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ hmm.  ] || ---------------- || First, I was given the opportunity to use the product through the Coupang Experience Group. I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd. They said that some of the materials were out of stock, so the delivery was stopped, and they told me about it and that they would install it around the 20th. I was completely shocked by the absurdity of the sudden statement-.-; I was trying to clean up the clutter of the table and appliances that had filled the living room to find the location and set it up again, and I was annoyed for the second time! Then, on the evening of the 14th, I got a happy call and they said they would come and install it between 12 and 1 PM on the 15th, so I told them to do so. As expected, they didn't come even though the time was up~ They called me saying they were late and came to install it after 2:30 -.-; The installation went smoothly after that, and they explained it well, but there was no specific reason or apology for the delay. The kitchen is small, so I couldn't tear down the sink or install a new one, so I requested a freestanding one and installed it. After installation, I put some old appliances on the countertop, such as a Nespresso Vertuo, blender, foamer, and electric kettle, and they are stable. First, since there is no dedicated detergent, I bought detergent today and tried it out. When I test-drove it after installation yesterday, the noise was so loud that it was annoying, but when I put the dishes in and turned it on, it was so quiet that I wondered if it was working. The noise and vibration were okay. I think the noise was caused by the water hitting the inside walls of the dishwasher in the empty space on the first day. If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ hmm.  ] || ---------------- || First, I was given the opportunity to use the product through the Coupang Experience Group. I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd. They said that some of the materials were out of stock, so the delivery was stopped, and they told me about it and that they would install it around the 20th. I was completely shocked by the absurdity of the sudden statement-.-; I was trying to clean up the clutter of the table and appliances that had filled the living room to find the location and set it up again, and I was annoyed for the second time! Then, on the evening of the 14th, I got a happy call and they said they would come and install it between 12 and 1 PM on the 15th, so I told them to do so. As expected, they didn't come even though the time was up~ They called me saying they were late and came to install it after 2:30 -.-; The installation went smoothly after that, and they explained it well, but there was no specific reason or apology for the delay. The kitchen is small, so I couldn't tear down the sink or install a new one, so I requested a freestanding one and installed it. After installation, I put some old appliances on the countertop, such as a Nespresso Vertuo, blender, foamer, and electric kettle, and they are stable. First, since there is no dedicated detergent, I bought detergent today and tried it out. When I test-drove it after installation yesterday, the noise was so loud that it was annoying, but when I put the dishes in and turned it on, it was so quiet that I wondered if it was working. The noise and vibration were okay. I think the noise was caused by the water hitting the inside walls of the dishwasher in the empty space on the first day. If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ hmm.  ] || ---------------- || First, I was given the opportunity to use the product through the Coupang Experience Group. I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd. I was completely shocked by the absurdity of the sudden statement-.-; I was trying to clean up the clutter of the table and appliances that had filled the living room to find the location and set it up again, and I was annoyed for the second time! Then, on the evening of the 14th, I got a happy call and they said they would come and install it between 12 and 1 PM on the 15th, so I told them to do so. As expected, they didn't come even though the time was up~ They called me saying they were late and came to install it after 2:30 -.-; The installation went smoothly after that, and they explained it well, but there was no specific reason or apology for the delay. The kitchen is small, so I couldn't tear down the sink or install a new one, so I requested a freestanding one and installed it. After installation, I put some old appliances on the countertop, such as a Nespresso Vertuo, blender, foamer, and electric kettle, and they are stable. First, since there is no dedicated detergent, I bought detergent today and tried it out. When I test-drove it after installation yesterday, the noise was so loud that it was annoying, but when I put the dishes in and turned it on, it was so quiet that I wondered if it was working. The noise and vibration were okay. I think the noise was caused by the water hitting the inside walls of the dishwasher in the empty space on the first day. If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ hmm.  ] || ---------------- || First, I was given the opportunity to use the product through the Coupang Experience Group. I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd. They said that some of the materials were out of stock, so the delivery was stopped, and they told me about it and that they would install it around the 20th. I was completely shocked by the absurdity of the sudden statement-.-; I was trying to clean up the clutter of the table and appliances that had filled the living room to find the location and set it up again, and I was annoyed for the second time! Then, on the evening of the 14th, I got a happy call and they said they would come and install it between 12 and 1 PM on the 15th, so I told them to do so. As expected, they didn't come even though the time was up~ They called me saying they were late and came to install it after 2:30 -.-; The installation went smoothly after that, and they explained it well, but there was no specific reason or apology for the delay. The kitchen is small, so I couldn't tear down the sink or install a new one, so I requested a freestanding one and installed it. After installation, I put some old appliances on the countertop, such as a Nespresso Vertuo, blender, foamer, and electric kettle, and they are stable. First, since there is no dedicated detergent, I bought detergent today and tried it out. When I test-drove it after installation yesterday, the noise was so loud that it was annoying, but when I put the dishes in and turned it on, it was so quiet that I wondered if it was working. The noise and vibration were okay. I think the noise was caused by the water hitting the inside walls of the dishwasher in the empty space on the first day. If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd. I was completely shocked by the absurdity of the sudden statement-.-; I was trying to clean up the clutter of the table and appliances that had filled the living room to find the location and set it up again, and I was annoyed for the second time! Then, on the evening of the 14th, I got a happy call and they said they would come and install it between 12 and 1 PM on the 15th, so I told them to do so. As expected, they didn't come even though the time was up~ They called me saying they were late and came to install it after 2:30 -.-; The installation went smoothly after that, and they explained it well, but there was no specific reason or apology for the delay. The kitchen is small, so I couldn't tear down the sink or install a new one, so I requested a freestanding one and installed it. After installation, I put some old appliances on the countertop, such as a Nespresso Vertuo, blender, foamer, and electric kettle, and they are stable. First, since there is no dedicated detergent, I bought detergent today and tried it out. When I test-drove it after installation yesterday, the noise was so loud that it was annoying, but when I put the dishes in and turned it on, it was so quiet that I wondered if it was working. The noise and vibration were okay. I think the noise was caused by the water hitting the inside walls of the dishwasher in the empty space on the first day. If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ hmm.  ] || ---------------- || First, I was given the opportunity to use the product through the Coupang Experience Group. I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd. They said that some of the materials were out of stock, so the delivery was stopped, and they told me about it and that they would install it around the 20th. I was completely shocked by the absurdity of the sudden statement-.-; I was trying to clean up the clutter of the table and appliances that had filled the living room to find the location and set it up again, and I was annoyed for the second time! Then, on the evening of the 14th, I got a happy call and they said they would come and install it between 12 and 1 PM on the 15th, so I told them to do so. As expected, they didn't come even though the time was up~ They called me saying they were late and came to install it after 2:30 -.-; The installation went smoothly after that, and they explained it well, but there was no specific reason or apology for the delay. The kitchen is small, so I couldn't tear down the sink or install a new one, so I requested a freestanding one and installed it. After installation, I put some old appliances on the countertop, such as a Nespresso Vertuo, blender, foamer, and electric kettle, and they are stable. First, since there is no dedicated detergent, I bought detergent today and tried it out. When I test-drove it after installation yesterday, the noise was so loud that it was annoying, but when I put the dishes in and turned it on, it was so quiet that I wondered if it was working. The noise and vibration were okay. I think the noise was caused by the water hitting the inside walls of the dishwasher in the empty space on the first day. If I was going to test it hard, I put in a pan where I coated pork belly, a cast-iron wok with mala-tang, and ceramics with lots of oil, silicone tongs, heat-resistant reusable containers, etc. and ran it on the standard course. The result was that the oil was completely removed from the coated pan, ceramics, plastic heat-resistant containers, silicone, etc.! The cast iron wasn't washed properly and still had some stains and food residue. The coffee cup didn't come off completely clean where the crema had touched. I think it's because of many variables, such as the amount of detergent, course, bowl position, and bowl shape. I'm a single-person household, but I'm a greedy maximalist, so I have a lot of dishes and a lot of trendy cast iron, so choosing the 12-person one seems like a great choice. Also, cast iron and large-sized cooking utensils are heavy, so my wrists were strained when washing them, but it's more convenient than I thought because I can just rinse them in a larva and put them in the dishwasher. The most satisfying thing is that I don't get my hands wet for a long time, I don't use detergent as much, and my stomach doesn't get wet! Although there aren't many dishes, they were oily, so I put in two water-soluble capsule detergents, and I didn't rinse them separately, but all the oil was removed and there were no remaining stains. You can choose the detergent you like~ When the washing is finished, the door opens automatically after the beep alarm~ The detergent inlet inside also opens automatically~ I should try drying later~ If only the delivery was not bad, I would have given it 4 stars. This made me think again about whether I should buy domestic brands, and when I asked the installers, they were not from the media, but rather outsourced the installation and some of the after-sales service to an external installation company, so it seems to be slow and unprofessional. As for the washing, the satisfaction level is about 80% at first glance. I wonder if the problem of the washing power or the material of the bowl itself is because the cast iron was not cleaned properly. However, as I mentioned earlier, it is convenient and I think it is cost-effective enough considering the price. The exterior is not pretty, but the cost-effectiveness makes up for it~ The operation is very simple and intuitive. It is also good that you can add dishwashing liquid in the middle~ The all-stainless steel interior seems hygienic. Freestanding tip? I've slightly modified the product review for Jeon Soo-cha. Since my kitchen is very narrow, I installed them as freestanding tables facing each other. I had to remove the table that was originally used as an island table, so I was worried about the space. Then, since the microwave and dishwasher are almost the same height, I bought a piece of 1200x600 pine board, placed it across, and covered it. It gave me a built-in effect and secured space. ^^ See the photos. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

전수차 상품평 수정을 약간함~ 주방이 ㄴ자로 좁아 마주보게 프리스텐딩으로 설치~ 원래 아일랜드 식탁처럼 쓰던 테이블을 빼야 했기게 공간 고민을 하다 마침 전자레인지대랑 식세기 높이가 거의 동일해 1200x600송판을 한장 구매해 가로지르고 덮었더니 나름 빌트인 효과와 공간확보가 됨^^ 사진참고~ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

I chose the dishwasher, one of the so-called three aunts that are said to greatly improve the convenience index, and I was really looking forward to it, but the delivery made me lose interest and lose progress from the beginning-.-; After two or three days, I heard the reason, and it was even more absurd.
